question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A fall of water from a great height
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e. **'Cascade'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that can substitute the phrase** "a fall of water from a great height"** is **"cascade."**
 
• **"Cascade" **is a noun that refers to a small waterfall, typically one of several that fall in stages down a steep rocky slope.(झरना)
 
• **It can also be used **more generally to describe anything that falls or rushes forth in large quantities.

The **correct answer **is:** 'Cascade'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"River" **- A river is a large, flowing body of water that usually empties into a sea or ocean.(नदी)
 
• **"Stream"** - A stream is a small, narrow river, but it does not inherently imply a fall of water from a height.(नाला)
 
• **"Typhoon"** - A typhoon is a mature tropical cyclone that develops in the western part of the North Pacific Ocean. (तूफ़ान)
